CFML Language Reference: Functions

BitMaskClear

Returns the number with length bits, starting at bit start (bit 0 is the lowest), set to zero. All other bits are left alone.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

BitMaskClear(number, start, length)

Parameters

number
A 32-bit integer.
start
Position of the lowest bit to clear, 0 to 31.
length
Number of bits to clear, 1 to 31.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

BitMaskClear(n, s, l) is shorthand for BitAnd(n, BitNot(BitSHLN(2^l - 1, s))). The result is a signed 32-bit integer, so clearing bits of a negative number may still give a negative number.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET n = 255>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Call</TH><TH>Result</TH><TH>Binary</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="args" LIST="0:4,4:4,2:3,7:1">
<CFSET s = ListFirst(args, ":")><CFSET l = ListLast(args, ":")>
<CFSET r = BitMaskClear(n, s, l)>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD><TT>BitMaskClear(#n#, #s#, #l#)</TT></TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#r#</TD>
<TD><TT>#Right("00000000" & FormatBaseN(r, 2), 8)#</TT></TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
